title: App review requirements
label: TIKTOK SHOP · DEVELOPER GUIDE
subtitle: Updated 2026-09-28
html:
Use this checklist before submitting your app for review. The requirements depend on your app type, category, target markets, features, and whether you build for your own shop or for other sellers. Give reviewers access to your app and clear materials showing how the features in your application work. If we cannot verify something, we may ask you for more information.

Rule ID Category Topic Applies to What to prepare or demonstrate
G-URL-001 General checks Product URL and identity Public App and Custom App submissions in all markets. Provide a valid, accessible product URL that is not a local-only address such as localhost. Reviewers may access either your production environment or a test environment provided for the review.
G-URL-002 General checks Product URL and identity Public App and Custom App submissions in all markets. Make the relationship between the URL, the submitted product, and its main features clear. Developer details, product descriptions, redirects, and actual features can establish this relationship. Products in the same product line, white-label products, and multi-platform products may use different brand names or domains.
G-URL-005 General checks Authorization return URL Apps that return users to the app after authorization. Configure a return URL that receives the authorization result and brings users back to the submitted app to continue using it. Successful authorization or subsequent app operations can demonstrate that the flow works. URLs containing staging, test, or dev are acceptable if they support this flow. A single failed access attempt alone is not grounds for rejection.
G-ACC-001 General checks Test account and sign-in Public App and Custom App submissions whose main features require sign-in. Provide the test account information and instructions needed to start your app's authentication flow. If you provide multiple accounts, identify which one to use and the app or test workspace it belongs to. The account must be usable with your app's authentication method; no particular account name or naming format is required for review.
G-ACC-002 General checks Test account and sign-in Public App and Custom App submissions whose main features require sign-in. Provide a test account that can complete your app's authentication flow and access the product pages intended for its user role.
G-ACC-003 General checks Test account and workspace Public App and Custom App submissions whose main features require sign-in. After authentication, the test account must open a usable workspace and provide access to the main features in your application. The workspace may have no existing shops, products, or orders, but the account must have enough access for reviewers to check the main features.
G-DEMO-001 General checks Demo video format and duration All App Review submissions, including Public App and Custom App. Submit a playable MP4 or MOV demo video lasting at least 10 seconds. A missing, damaged, unsupported, or shorter video does not meet the material requirements.
G-DEMO-002 General checks Materials for the submitted product Submissions containing a demo video, screenshots, or other demonstration materials. Provide materials showing the submitted product and its main features. You may reuse a demo of the same product's common features from any market for all regional reviews. For market-specific features, use video, screenshots, product descriptions, or accessible product pages to show that the relevant requirements are met. You do not need a separate video for every market.
G-DEMO-006 General checks Test instructions All App Review submissions. Provide enough instructions for reviewers to access the product, use the test account, and check the main features. Instructions, videos, and actual product pages can complement each other.
G-DEMO-007 General checks Functional screenshots and demo Submissions containing product screenshots or demo videos. Screenshots must show recognizable, clear functional pages of the submitted product. Videos must mainly show actual product use, including the required TikTok Shop authorization or connected state, main feature pages, and operation results. Promotional posters, marketing graphics, or videos showing only advertising text or static slides do not demonstrate functionality. Blurred, obscured, or excessively fast footage that prevents review of the main features does not meet this requirement.
G-DEMO-005 General checks Core features in the application All App Review submissions. Implement the core business features explicitly described in your application. The requirements cover the features you offer in this application and any mandatory features that explicitly apply to it.
G-DEMO-009 General checks TikTok Shop integration Apps whose application describes reading or processing TikTok Shop data. Provide evidence that can be linked to the app's TikTok Shop integration, such as an authorized shop connection, sync records, feature pages, or operation results. A TikTok Shop logo, a correctly formatted ID, a written description, or simulated data alone does not prove integration.
G-AUTH-001 General checks Authorization entry and flow Apps whose features require a TikTok Shop shop, creator account, or publishing account connection. Provide a clear entry point for the required TikTok Shop authorization, followed by registration, sign-in, or entry into the app. Users must not need to copy authorization codes manually.
G-AUTH-003 General checks Required authorization Apps whose features require a TikTok Shop shop, creator account, or publishing account connection. Support the authorization required by the business: authorize the shop to read shop data or act for the shop, the creator account to act as a creator, and the relevant publishing account to publish content. After authorization, the app must be able to read the corresponding data and use the features described in the application.
G-AUTH-005 General checks Authorization identity and scope Apps whose features require a TikTok Shop shop, creator account, or publishing account connection. Support the seller scope and authorization types covered by your application. The authorization shown in your demo must belong to the submitted product, but the demo account's market does not need to match the market under review. If display names differ, explain the relationship using the Service ID, developer details, or product relationship.
G-API-005 General checks Platform notifications Apps whose stated features depend on TikTok Shop notifications, such as order changes, invoice-validation results, or video-precheck results. Receive the TikTok Shop notifications needed by your business and use them to update the corresponding data or status. You may demonstrate this through configuration, logs, demos, or results shown in the product. A live notification does not need to be triggered during review.
G-CAT-001 General checks App category Public App and Custom App submissions in all markets. Choose a category that matches your product's actual main business features, and demonstrate the substantive features for that category. Your product may cover several business categories.
G-NAME-001 General checks App name Public App and Custom App submissions in all markets. Use an official product name rather than a development or test placeholder such as dev or test. A brand name followed by the app's function is acceptable, but this naming format is not mandatory.
G-BIZ-001 General checks Lending services Public App and Custom App submissions in all markets. Do not provide lending services that the platform does not support. Non-lending financial features, such as bookkeeping and profit analysis, are not excluded by this restriction.
G-LANG-001 General checks Language for target sellers Public App and Custom App submissions in all markets that present an app name, website, sign-in page, or business workflow to sellers. Use an app name and core workflows that your target sellers can understand. For US local sellers, support English. Apps explicitly serving only Chinese-speaking US sellers may use Chinese if the app name or service description identifies this audience. Chinese is also acceptable for China-based cross-border sellers and US ACCU sellers (American companies with a Chinese ultimate beneficial owner). For other local-seller markets, support the local language. The required language may be available through a language switch and does not need to be the default. You do not need to translate every image or piece of supporting text.
CS-002 Feature-specific checks Customer support Apps in the Customer Support category whose main function is handling TikTok Shop customer inquiries. Provide complete features for viewing and replying to customer messages. Working product pages, demo materials, or examples of the same product handling messages on another e-commerce platform can demonstrate this. The test account does not need real TikTok Shop messages or pending conversations.
CS-005 Feature-specific checks Customer support tickets Customer-support apps whose application includes support-ticket management. Allow users to create support tickets or update their handling status. Customer-support products that do not offer ticket management are not required to add a ticket module.
ERP-001 Feature-specific checks Product management Apps that offer TikTok Shop product import, creation, publication, or editing in this application. Complete the product operations offered in your application, using the correct products, product information, and results. If you offer product creation or publication, support the required category, attribute, and variation information and complete the corresponding operation.
ERP-002 Feature-specific checks Order management ERP or order-management apps that read and process TikTok Shop orders. Demonstrate the TikTok Shop order-reading or processing features described in your application. You may use historical authorization records, order-sync records, demos, and product pages together. The current test account does not need orders available for processing. If you show static simulated orders, include other evidence of the TikTok Shop integration.
ERP-003 Feature-specific checks Inventory management ERP or inventory-management apps that read, update, or sync product inventory. Support the inventory reading, updating, or syncing functions described in your application. You only need to provide the inventory operations included in that scope.
ERP-004 Feature-specific checks Fulfillment status updates ERP or order-management apps that process orders in the app and send fulfillment status back to TikTok Shop. Support the fulfillment-status updates to TikTok Shop described in your application. You may demonstrate this through demos, records, design information, and matching status changes for the same order. A real shipment does not need to be executed during review. If current order records are unavailable, use other supporting materials to demonstrate the update capability.
DC-002 Feature-specific checks Data connectors Apps connecting TikTok Shop to another system through the API reads or event notifications described in the application. Transfer the stated TikTok Shop data or event notifications to the target system and produce sync results that can be matched to the source.
AFF-001 Feature-specific checks Creator search Creator-collaboration apps that either come from a US-registered provider serving US local sellers or describe creator search in the application. Allow users to search for creators in the target market using relevant filters when creator search is required for your application.
AFF-004 Feature-specific checks Creator messaging Creator-collaboration apps that either come from a US-registered provider serving US local sellers or describe creator messaging in the application. Provide creator messaging and conversation pages, including the ability to send direct messages to creators.
G-API-006 Feature-specific checks Restricted creator APIs Apps applying to use restricted Affiliate or creator-collaboration APIs. Provide a valid invitation or other evidence of access approval for the restricted APIs in your application. If your eligibility has changed or the evidence is incomplete, provide clarification or current supporting materials.
G-RISK-002 Feature-specific checks Dropshipping Apps providing dropshipping that involves storage and shipping in a target market. Provide materials showing the local warehouse and order-shipping process. These materials must demonstrate that your dropshipping operation meets the local-warehouse requirement.
G-RISK-003 Feature-specific checks Print on demand Apps providing print-on-demand services that make products to customer requirements after receiving an order. Provide business qualifications, warehouse information, and an explanation of how your product differs from existing offerings. These materials should make it possible to verify your qualifications and understand the product's differences.
G-RISK-004 Feature-specific checks Product licenses and authorization Apps whose application involves branded, restricted, or other products requiring sales licenses or authorization. Provide clear evidence of the sales licenses or authorization required for the products your app handles. If the required authorization remains unclear after review, the application will be rejected. Supply the missing licenses or evidence before resubmitting.
SV-INV-001 Feature-specific checks Shoppable video: invitation and access Apps applying for Shoppable Content integration. Provide a valid invitation or other evidence of access approval for the Shoppable Content integration in this application. If your eligibility has changed or the evidence is incomplete, provide clarification or current supporting materials.
SV-002 Feature-specific checks Shoppable video: creation and editing All apps applying for Shoppable Content integration. Provide actual video-creation or editing capabilities. Either AI-assisted or manual creation and editing is acceptable; AI is not mandatory.
SV-003 Feature-specific checks Shoppable video: creation and editing Third-party Shoppable Content apps from ISVs registered in mainland China, Hong Kong, Macao, or Taiwan that serve US cross-border or ACCU sellers. Provide an actual video-creation or editing service. Only managing, uploading, publishing, or moving existing videos does not meet this requirement.
SV-UC-04 Feature-specific checks Shoppable video: generation Shoppable-video apps whose stated features include generating videos from product information or source materials. When video generation is required by your integration plan, support generating videos from product information or source materials. You may demonstrate this through app operations or the generated videos. If your demo does not show this feature, provide other materials that demonstrate it.
SV-005 Feature-specific checks Shoppable video: creator authorization Shoppable-video apps that either come from ISVs registered in mainland China, Hong Kong, Macao, or Taiwan serving US cross-border or ACCU sellers, or include creator authorization and disconnection in their stated features. Support connections to the creator accounts served by this app within the markets covered by your application. Provide a way to disconnect the account and show the result.
SV-UC-02 Feature-specific checks Shoppable video: creator type Shoppable-video apps whose stated features include identifying creator types, such as official shop accounts, channel accounts, or affiliate creators. Read and use the relevant creator type, such as an official shop account, channel account, or affiliate creator. This feature is required only when specified in your integration plan.
SV-UC-03 Feature-specific checks Shoppable video: eligible products Shoppable-video apps whose stated features include selecting products from a creator's eligible shops or showcase. When product selection is required by your integration plan, retrieve the list of products that the selected creator is eligible to promote. The list must belong to the correct creator.
SV-UC-05 Feature-specific checks Shoppable video: upload Shoppable-video apps whose stated features include uploading video files to TikTok Shop. Upload video files and obtain the video-file information returned by the platform for later publication.
SV-UC-06 Feature-specific checks Shoppable video: pre-publication checks Shoppable-video apps whose application includes policy-violation checks before publication. Submit videos for the platform's policy checks before publication, read the results, and prevent videos that fail the checks from being published.
SV-009 Feature-specific checks Shoppable video: API publication Shoppable-video apps from ISVs registered in mainland China, Hong Kong, Macao, or Taiwan serving US cross-border or ACCU sellers, or other shoppable-video apps whose application explicitly offers video publication through APIs. Publish videos through APIs and link them to products. A flow that only directs users to publish manually in another system does not meet an API-publication requirement.
SV-UC-07 Feature-specific checks Shoppable video: product purchase links Shoppable-video apps that either offer API publication with a product purchase entry in their application or come from ISVs registered in mainland China, Hong Kong, Macao, or Taiwan serving US cross-border or ACCU sellers. Link the published video to the product selected by the seller, and make the video's purchase entry open that product. A missing or incorrect product link can cause rejection.
SV-UC-08 Feature-specific checks Shoppable video: publication result Shoppable-video apps that either offer API publication with a product purchase entry in their application or come from ISVs registered in mainland China, Hong Kong, Macao, or Taiwan serving US cross-border or ACCU sellers. Retrieve the final video-publication result: success or failure. For a failure, retrieve the reason and support any needed retry operation. Do not leave the result permanently at processing. Provide materials demonstrating that your app can obtain and handle the final result.
SV-UC-12 Feature-specific checks Shoppable video: performance data Shoppable-video apps whose application includes reading and displaying video-performance data. Read and display video-performance metrics when required by your integration plan. Use data APIs that support the selected market. Apps whose integration plan does not require this feature do not need to add it.
SV-UC-13 Feature-specific checks Shoppable video: covers Shoppable-video apps whose stated features include selecting or setting a video cover. Allow users to choose or set a video cover when this feature is required by your integration plan. Otherwise, the feature is not mandatory.
SV-UC-14 Feature-specific checks Shoppable video: music search Shoppable-video apps whose stated features include searching music for commerce content. Allow users to search for music permitted for commerce content when music search is required by your integration plan. Only the music-search functions included in that plan are required.
SV-UC-15 Feature-specific checks Shoppable video: background music Shoppable-video apps whose stated features include adding background music. Allow users to add the selected background music to a video when music binding is required by your integration plan. You may demonstrate this through app operations or the resulting video; a recording of the settings interface is not required if other materials demonstrate the feature.
G-CAT-002 Market-specific checks US local sellers: category Apps applying to serve US local sellers. Do not select the closed Product Design and Sourcing category when that closure applies to your application.
AFF-002 Market-specific checks US local creator collaboration: creator ID Creator-collaboration apps that either come from a US-registered provider serving US local sellers or describe displaying creator IDs in the application. Make the creator ID identifiable on the results page for US local applications from a US-registered provider, or when your application otherwise explicitly requires creator IDs. This US-specific requirement does not automatically apply to other markets.
AFF-003 Market-specific checks US local creator collaboration: invitations Creator-collaboration apps that either come from a US-registered provider serving US local sellers or describe bulk targeted invitations in the application. Allow users to select multiple creators and send targeted invitations in one operation.
SV-007 Market-specific checks US cross-border or ACCU shoppable video: shop connection Shoppable Content apps from ISVs registered in mainland China, Hong Kong, Macao, or Taiwan that serve US cross-border or ACCU sellers. Support connections to the US shops required for the US cross-border or ACCU business covered by your application. This requirement applies to the apps described in this row, not to all shoppable-video apps in other markets.
SV-008 Market-specific checks US cross-border or ACCU shoppable video: installation Shoppable Content apps from ISVs registered in mainland China, Hong Kong, Macao, or Taiwan that serve US cross-border or ACCU sellers. Let sellers install and authorize the app directly from TikTok Shop Seller Center.
SV-010 Market-specific checks US cross-border or ACCU shoppable video: publication evidence Shoppable Content apps from ISVs registered in mainland China, Hong Kong, Macao, or Taiwan that serve US cross-border or ACCU sellers. Provide a test video-publication result that can be linked to this app. Publication records from unrelated apps cannot demonstrate your app's capability. If a publication record is unavailable, we may ask for other evidence of this app's publishing capability.
G-RISK-001 Market-specific checks US cross-border fulfillment: local warehouse Apps serving US cross-border or ACCU sellers whose application includes shipping or fulfillment. Provide evidence of local warehousing in the US and business materials supporting your fulfillment operation. The materials must allow the warehouse's authenticity and eligibility for the proposed business to be verified.
BR-BASIC-001 Market-specific checks Brazil Public App: screenshots Public App submissions serving Brazil local sellers. Provide professional, clear screenshots that show and explain your app's functions. The screenshots must be relevant and readable enough to understand the features; blurry or unrelated images are not sufficient.
BR-BASIC-003 Market-specific checks Brazil Public App: feature description Public App submissions serving Brazil local sellers. Describe the functions offered to Brazil sellers and make sure the description matches the actual product. If the main functions are unclear, provide more detail.
BR-BASIC-004 Market-specific checks Brazil Public App: product consistency Public App submissions serving Brazil local sellers. Make the description, screenshots, video, and website clearly identifiable as this product and its main business. Multi-brand or multi-platform materials may include different names or content from other platforms; explain the relationship between the developer, product, and TikTok Shop features. Materials for an unrelated product cannot demonstrate your app's functionality. If a feature is not shown in the demo, you may demonstrate it through other supporting materials.
BR-BASIC-006 Market-specific checks Brazil Public App: fulfillment evidence Public App submissions serving Brazil local sellers and offering order shipping or fulfillment, such as ERP, connector, or logistics apps. For high-risk shipping operations, provide order-handling, warehouse, and shipping evidence that demonstrates how your business operates.
MAP-br-custom Market-specific checks Brazil Custom App: test materials Custom App submissions serving Brazil local sellers. Provide a working product URL, valid test account, clear test instructions, and materials showing the main features. Include a playable demo video lasting at least 10 seconds. Missing essential materials must be supplied before the application can meet the review requirements.
BR-BASIC-005 Market-specific checks Brazil: app category Public App and Custom App submissions serving Brazil local sellers. Choose a category for which your app provides substantive features. A broad ERP or similar product may cover accounting, order management, and product management at the same time. Offering other business features does not make the selected category incorrect, but your app must provide the core function of that category.
BR-FUL-001 Market-specific checks Brazil: invoice validation Public App submissions serving Brazil local sellers and offering order shipping. After uploading an invoice, wait for the platform's validation result. Upload success alone does not mean that invoice validation passed.
BR-FUL-002 Market-specific checks Brazil: invoice and order notifications Public App submissions serving Brazil local sellers and offering order shipping. Receive invoice-validation results and order-status notifications from the platform, and update the app's processing status accordingly.
BR-FUL-003 Market-specific checks Brazil: ready to ship Public App submissions serving Brazil local sellers and offering order shipping. In the production fulfillment flow, advance an order to ready to ship or shipment only after invoice validation passes and the order status allows shipment. You may demonstrate this through process descriptions, configuration, logs, demos, or production results. If a TTSPC test shop cannot complete NF-e validation, use those materials to demonstrate the capability; the test order does not need a final validated status.
BR-FUL-004 Market-specific checks Brazil: sample and gift invoices Apps serving Brazil local sellers whose stated features include shipping sample or gift orders. Handle the corresponding invoices for sample and gift orders. Do not skip them solely because the order value is zero.
BR-ERP-001 Market-specific checks Brazil ERP/connectors: shop mapping ERP or connector apps serving Brazil Local sellers that offer data synchronization or shop mapping between another e-commerce platform and TikTok Shop in this application. For the cross-platform connections or syncing described in your application, correctly associate each external-platform shop with the corresponding TikTok Shop shop. Multi-platform products may display shops from other platforms. The connection must link the correct shops and support the functions described in your application.
BR-ERP-002 Market-specific checks Brazil ERP/connectors: carrier mapping ERP or connector apps serving Brazil local sellers that use Seller Shipping, with third-party logistics arranged by the seller. Map the logistics company used for Seller Shipping to a carrier supported by TikTok Shop.
BR-ERP-003 Market-specific checks Brazil product listing: category mapping ERP, connector, or product-listing apps serving Brazil local sellers whose application includes TikTok Shop product-category mapping. Map the product categories handled by your app to the corresponding TikTok Shop categories for the product module offered in your application.
BR-ERP-004 Market-specific checks Brazil product listing: shop setup ERP, connector, or product-listing apps serving Brazil Local sellers that offer product syncing or publication to TikTok Shop in this application. Before syncing or publishing products, check whether the seller has completed the required TikTok Shop setup for product listing. If not, prompt the seller to complete it and make completion a required step in the integration flow.
BR-ERP-005 Market-specific checks Brazil product listing: required attributes Apps serving Brazil local sellers that offer product publication in categories with required attributes or qualifications. Fulfillment-only apps are excluded. Allow sellers to enter the required attributes and submit the qualifications applicable to the product. Only the requirements for that product apply; requirements for other products do not add extra evidence requirements.
BR-ERP-006 Market-specific checks Brazil product listing: brands Apps serving Brazil local sellers that offer product publication and handle branded products. Fulfillment-only apps are excluded. Allow sellers to select or map the correct TikTok Shop brand for branded products.
BR-ERP-007 Market-specific checks Brazil product listing: package dimensions ERP, connector, or product-listing apps serving Brazil local sellers whose application includes TikTok Shop product publication and package-dimension entry. Allow users to enter and sync the package dimensions required for the product, including length, width, and height.
BR-ERP-008 Market-specific checks Brazil product listing: warehouse selection ERP, connector, or product-listing apps serving Brazil local sellers whose stated product-publication flow includes warehouse selection. Allow users to select the warehouse required by the workflow and sync its information.
BR-ERP-009 Market-specific checks Brazil product listing: description formatting ERP, connector, or product-listing apps serving Brazil local sellers whose application includes syncing or publishing product descriptions to TikTok Shop. Preserve and display product-description formatting correctly after syncing to TikTok Shop. Formatting errors must not make the description incorrect.
BR-ERP-010 Market-specific checks Brazil product listing: dependent attributes Apps serving Brazil local sellers that offer product publication in categories where later required attributes depend on an earlier selection. When an attribute choice makes further fields mandatory, show those fields and guide the seller to complete them.
BR-ERP-011 Market-specific checks Brazil product listing: publication ERP, connector, or product-listing apps targeting Brazil Local (L2L) sellers whose application includes TikTok Shop product publication. Publish products successfully to TikTok Shop.
BR-ERP-012 Market-specific checks Brazil product listing: inventory ERP, connector, or product-listing apps serving Brazil local sellers whose application includes updating inventory for TikTok Shop products or variations. Update inventory quantities for the corresponding TikTok Shop product variations.
BR-ERP-013 Market-specific checks Brazil product listing: price ERP, connector, or product-listing apps serving Brazil local sellers whose application includes updating prices for TikTok Shop products or variations. Update the price of a TikTok Shop product or its individual variation.
BR-ERP-014 Market-specific checks Brazil product listing: updates ERP, connector, or product-listing apps serving Brazil local sellers whose application includes editing and syncing published TikTok Shop products. Edit information for published products and sync those changes to TikTok Shop.
BR-ERP-015 Market-specific checks Brazil order sync: import Full-service or fulfillment-only ERP and connector apps serving Brazil local sellers that offer TikTok Shop order syncing and processing. Demonstrate the TikTok Shop order-import function described in your application. You may use submitted demos, shop authorizations, sync logs, and order pages together. If you show static simulated orders, include other evidence of the integration. An empty current test account does not by itself mean the feature is missing.
BR-ERP-016 Market-specific checks Brazil order sync: status changes Full-service or fulfillment-only ERP and connector apps serving Brazil local sellers that offer TikTok Shop order syncing and processing. Reflect TikTok Shop order-status changes in the app when this syncing is included in your application. You may use demos, sync logs, pages, or design records for the same order together to demonstrate the capability. A real status change does not need to occur in the current test account. If live orders are unavailable, use other supporting materials.
BR-ERP-017 Market-specific checks Brazil order sync: Webhooks Full-service or fulfillment-only ERP and connector apps serving Brazil local sellers that offer TikTok Shop order syncing and processing. Integrate TikTok Shop order-related Webhooks, receive order and status-change notifications, and update order data accordingly.
BR-ERP-018 Market-specific checks Brazil order sync: recovery Full-service or fulfillment-only ERP and connector apps serving Brazil local sellers that offer TikTok Shop order syncing and processing. Query for and recover missing order information when platform notifications fail. Design descriptions, configuration, and records can demonstrate this. You do not need to recreate every failure scenario in a demo.
BR-ERP-019 Market-specific checks Brazil: sample and gift orders ERP or connector apps serving Brazil local sellers whose order-sync scope includes samples sent to creators or free gift products. Import sample and gift orders and correctly identify or match them.
BR-ERP-022 Market-specific checks Brazil: third-party shipping ERP or connector apps serving Brazil local sellers that offer Seller Shipping through third-party logistics arranged by the seller. Sync third-party logistics information to TikTok Shop, including changes made after the package has shipped.
BR-ERP-023 Market-specific checks Brazil: shipping invoices ERP or connector apps serving Brazil local sellers whose stated features include order shipping. Upload order invoices, receive and process the platform's validation results, and continue production fulfillment after successful validation. Stop progression when validation fails. You may demonstrate this through process descriptions, configuration, logs, demos, or production results. If a TTSPC test shop cannot complete NF-e validation, use those materials to demonstrate the capability; the test order does not need a final validated status.
BR-ERP-024 Market-specific checks Brazil: sample and gift invoices ERP or connector apps serving Brazil local sellers whose fulfillment scope includes zero-value sample or gift orders. Generate or upload the corresponding invoices for sample or gift orders and handle the platform's invoice results.
BR-ERP-025 Market-specific checks Brazil: 4PL shipping labels ERP or connector apps serving Brazil local sellers that offer TikTok Shipping (4PL) fulfillment. Make TikTok Shipping (4PL) labels available for sellers to obtain and print. A downloadable PDF or another printable format is acceptable; ZPL is not required. Product pages or demos may demonstrate that printable labels are available. You do not need to connect a physical printer during review.
BR-ACC-001 Market-specific checks Brazil: accounting and reconciliation Public App submissions in accounting or settlement reconciliation that serve Brazil local sellers. Provide financial features with value beyond an ordinary order list, such as views of revenue, fees, costs, profit, platform settlements, or settlement differences. You do not need every report type or an end-to-end settlement result for every order. An ordinary order list without usable financial analysis or reconciliation does not meet this requirement.
BR-ACC-002 Market-specific checks Brazil: settlement differences Public App submissions in accounting or settlement reconciliation that serve Brazil local sellers and describe settlement-difference checks in the application. Identify or display differences between platform settlements and receivables as described in your application. You may demonstrate the feature through descriptions, working pages, or reports; the current test account does not need an order with a settlement difference.
BR-ACC-003 Market-specific checks Brazil: profit-and-loss or expense reports Public App submissions in accounting or settlement reconciliation that serve Brazil local sellers and describe profit-and-loss or expense reports in the application. Display the revenue, expenses, or profit information corresponding to the profit-and-loss or expense reports offered in your application. Descriptions, charts, and pages may demonstrate this. You do not need every report type or reports generated from current real orders.
CS-004 Market-specific checks Brazil: order-related customer support Apps in the Customer Support category serving Brazil local sellers and handling inquiries related to orders. Make the customer or order information needed to handle an inquiry available while users are handling it.
ERP-005 Market-specific checks Mexico cross-border ERP: split before shipping ERP apps serving China-based cross-border sellers in Mexico and shipping Mexico GS POP orders. Support splitting an order into packages before shipment. An app that cannot split orders, or can do so only after shipping, does not meet this requirement.
G-TYPE-002 App-type checks Developer role All App Review submissions. Choose the developer role that matches whom your app serves: a seller-developed app is for your own shops, while a third-party provider's app serves other sellers. Public App and Custom App describe the distribution type; they do not determine the developer role.
